title: Google Search Update Calendar v1.0
description: Versioned, machine-readable record of Google Search ranking-affecting updates, used by the measurement layer (R-137) to annotate whether a report window overlaps a core/spam/ranking update. Built from the official Google Search Status Dashboard JSON feed (https://status.search.google.com/incidents.json) by scripts/maintenance/refresh_update_calendar.py, filtered to service_name=='Ranking'. The engine ships a curated seed (google-update-calendar.json at repo root, same layout as mcp-tool-registry.json); runtime refresh writes a workspace overlay (shared/cache/google-update-calendar.json) that wins on id collision. Never hand-edited — refresh from the dashboard so update names/dates stay non-fabricated (Foundational Principle 1).

schema_version.description: Calendar file schema version. Additive changes keep this const (ADR-018 precedent).

retrieved_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp the dashboard feed was last fetched (rules/time-discipline.md). Display layer surfaces staleness.

updates.description: Ranking-service updates, newest-first by begin. End is nullable for still-rolling updates.

id.description: Dashboard incident id (stable key for overlay merge / dedup).

name.description: Human-readable update name (dashboard external_desc), e.g. 'May 2026 core update'.

end.description: UTC ISO-8601 rollout-complete timestamp (Z suffix), or null while the update is still rolling out.

service_name.description: Dashboard service_name. The calendar is filtered to 'Ranking' at build time; overlaps() re-asserts this filter at read time.

source.description: Provenance tag for the row, e.g. 'google_status_dashboard'.
